# Cover letter draft: Head of Technology (Remote / Work from Home) at KIK Innovation

Dear Hiring Manager,

I am applying for the Head of Technology (Remote / Work from Home) role at KIK Innovation. I am a senior technology leader based in Melbourne with 25 years across ICT management, cyber security and digital transformation, including Chief Information Officer and Head of Technology appointments. I work remotely on Australian Eastern time and have led distributed teams and vendors across Asia Pacific, the USA, the UK and India.

The pattern of my career matches what this role appears to need. I inherit fragmented or under-invested ICT functions, establish governance and a security baseline, rebuild the team and vendor model, and reduce cost while lifting service levels. Three examples:

- Scaled ICT for a global insurance services business through growth from 165 to more than 1,000 employees and revenue from $20M to $80M per annum, delivering approximately 10% cost reduction and 10% productivity improvement year on year.
- Built and launched an automated end-to-end online lending platform from inception to live operations as CIO, then reused the learnings to rebuild the No Interest Loans Scheme platform.
- Implemented Essential Eight Maturity Level 3 in two separate regulated organisations, and ISO 27001 security processes across Asia Pacific.

Your posting emphasises strategy, not-for-profit, charity. My most relevant recent experience:

**Senior ICT Manager, BirdLife Australia (May 2025 - Present)**
- Full accountability for ICT strategy, operations, security and budget for a national not-for-profit, reporting to the Executive Director, Finance and Business Improvement. Team of four.
- Delivered a new e-commerce capability consolidating product sales, one-off and recurring donations and memberships into a single supporter transaction channel.

**Chief Information Officer, Good Shepherd Microfinance (Jun 2016 - May 2019)**
- Owned ICT strategy, delivery and service through a cloud-based business transformation.
- Built and launched an automated end-to-end online lending platform from inception to operations across PaaS, IaaS and SaaS in multiple cloud environments.

**Head of Data, Digital and Technology, Independent Schools Victoria (Nov 2023 - May 2025)**
- Led a team of eight across software development, security, infrastructure, research and relationship management.
- Set and executed the data, digital and technology strategy underpinning advocacy, professional learning, school improvement and compliance across the independent schools sector.

I am comfortable at board and executive level and remain hands-on with delivery. I would welcome a conversation about how I can help KIK Innovation.

Kind regards,
Mathew Hema
mathew.rua.hema@gmail.com
Melbourne, Australia (AEST/AEDT)

# Screening answers: Head of Technology (Remote / Work from Home) at KIK Innovation

**Where are you located and what hours will you work?**
Melbourne, Australia. I work remotely on AEST/AEDT and routinely overlap with APAC, US Pacific mornings and UK afternoons. I have run regional operations reporting to a Global CIO in the USA with teams in the UK and India, so asynchronous and cross time zone delivery is normal for me.

**Do you have the right to work?**
Australian citizen or permanent resident (confirm wording before use)

**Why are you leaving your current role?**
I have delivered the security uplift, integration and e-commerce programme I was brought in to do at BirdLife Australia and I am looking for a larger remit. Adjust this to the truth of the moment before sending.

**Salary expectation?**
Full-time from AUD 160,000 base plus super depending on scope. Contract or fractional from AUD 900 per day. State a range only when asked; ask for theirs first.

**Notice period?**
Four weeks. Confirm your contract before answering.

**What is your experience with strategy, not-for-profit, charity?**
Draw from: Full accountability for ICT strategy, operations, security and budget for a national not-for-profit, reporting to the Executive Director, Finance and Business Improvement. Team of four.; Delivered a new e-commerce capability consolidating product sales, one-off and recurring donations and memberships into a single supporter transaction channel.; Owned ICT strategy, delivery and service through a cloud-based business transformation.; Built and launched an automated end-to-end online lending platform from inception to operations across PaaS, IaaS and SaaS in multiple cloud environments.

**Describe a time you reduced cost without hurting service.**
Crawford & Company Asia Pacific: managed a $5M+ regional ICT budget and delivered about 10% cost reduction and 10% productivity improvement year on year while the business grew from 165 to over 1,000 staff. Good Shepherd Microfinance: reduced ICT cost every quarter while maintaining SLAs during a cloud transformation.

**Describe your security leadership.**
Implemented Essential Eight Maturity Level 3 in two regulated organisations (Partners Wealth Group and Medical Indemnity Protection Society) and ISO 27001 processes across Asia Pacific at Crawford. Currently leading an Essential Eight aligned uplift with a SaaS and identity overlay at BirdLife Australia, reported to the board.
